errors.text_span: beginnen 1991 bei etwa 3,2 % des BIP, fallen bis 2000 auf etwa 2,3 %
errors.evidence: The description states values of 3.2% and 2.3% but the figure shows approximately 3.0% and 2.5%.
The description does not mention that the charts represent gross and net public investment relative to GDP.
The description does not indicate that the left diagram is a stacked bar chart and the right diagram a combined bar and line chart.
The y-axis description lacks mention of the axis units being percentage (%) of GDP.
